outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Prescott Parks and Recreation District asks for levy to support pool" (Jeremy Burnham, 2025-10-18)
notes: The 2025 request: $175,000, about 35 cents per $1,000 (about $70 on a $200,000 home), one year; presented every year; the 2024 levy was $145,000 (about 31 cents); passed in all years but one for more than two decades; needs 60%. District spans parts of Walla Walla and Columbia counties.
